data.name: Settings_AnswerInfoHashSamplingHint
data.value: Lets other DHT nodes ask which torrents you have peers for, which search indexes use to discover torrents. The same information is already available by asking who has a specific torrent, so turning this off hides little. Requires DHT.

data.name: Settings_AllowMultipleConnectionsPerIp
data.value: Allow several connections per IP address

data.name: Settings_AllowMultipleConnectionsPerIpHint
data.value: Keeps peers that share one address, as mobile and campus networks do when many subscribers sit behind the same one. Turning it off admits a single connection per address, and refuses a peer that reconnects from a new port instead of recognising it.

data.name: Settings_ListeningPortHint
data.value: Peerfluence uses the same port for TCP and UDP. Automatic mode asks the OS for available ports when the engine starts.

data.name: Settings_PortRestartHint
data.value: Listening port changes apply the next time Peerfluence starts.

data.value: {0} of {1} indexers answered. Some results may be missing.

data.value: Peerfluence has no index of its own. It searches through a Torznab endpoint you run yourself, such as Prowlarr or Jackett.

data.value: Address filled in. Checking whether it answers...

data.name: Settings_Search_Detecting
data.value: Looking for an indexer manager on this machine...

data.value: Found one. Add the API key from that app's own settings.

data.name: Find_Failure_Rejected

data.name: Find_Failure_NotTorznab

data.value: Nothing answered at {0}. Start Prowlarr or Jackett, then test again.

data.name: Settings_Search_TestRejected

data.name: Settings_Search_TestNotTorznab
data.value: Something answered, but it was not a Torznab feed. Check the address.

data.name: Find_Failure_RateLimited
data.value: {0} asked to be given a moment. Try again shortly.

data.name: Settings_SpeedLimitHint
data.value: Zero means no limit. Takes effect immediately, without restarting anything.

data.name: Settings_CategoriesHint
data.value: Group downloads, and give each group a folder of its own. A category without a folder still groups; it just leaves downloads where they would have gone.

data.name: Settings_RemoteHint
data.value: Lets other programs drive Peerfluence over the Transmission protocol, which is what Sonarr, Radarr and similar tools speak. Off by default, and reachable only from this machine unless you say otherwise.

data.name: Settings_Remote_NeedsCredentials
data.value: Reaching this from another machine needs a username and password. Without them, remote control will not start.

data.name: Settings_Remote_RestartHint
data.value: Changes here take effect the next time Peerfluence starts.

data.name: Settings_Search_ProwlarrNeedsIndexerId
data.value: Address filled in, but replace the 1 with your indexer's id - Prowlarr gives each indexer its own address and has no combined one. The id is in the address bar when you open an indexer in Prowlarr.

data.name: Notification_ListenPortChangedBody
data.value: Port {0} could not be bound, so {1} is in use instead. Update your router’s port forwarding to match.

data.name: Notification_ProxyRestrictedBody
data.value: An HTTP proxy is configured, so DHT and uTP are off for this session. Use a SOCKS5 proxy to keep them.

data.name: Details_MoveStorage_Success
data.value: Download path changed and the data moved

data.name: Details_WebSeeds_Rejected
data.value: That is not a usable web seed address, or the torrent already has it.

data.name: Details_WebSeeds_Empty
data.value: This torrent has no web seeds.

data.name: Details_SuperSeedingHint
data.value: For one seed introducing new content to an empty swarm. Turn it off afterwards: against an established swarm it holds back peers that could download freely.

data.name: Settings_BindAddressHint
data.value: Send everything from one local address, such as your VPN’s. Traffic stops rather than leaving by another route if that address goes away, which is what makes it a kill switch. Leave blank to use every interface. Port mapping is turned off while this is set.

data.name: Settings_MaxConnectionsPerIpHint
data.value: How many connections one address may hold on a single torrent. 0 is unlimited. A single peer briefly holds more than one while a dial tries both transports, so set this from what your network looks like rather than low on principle.

data.name: Settings_BindAddressInvalid
data.value: Not an address this can bind to. Use one of your machine’s own addresses, not 0.0.0.0.

data.name: Settings_SeedingHint
data.value: Applies to torrents added from now on. Each torrent can still be given goals of its own.

data.name: Stats_Hint
data.value: Counted since Peerfluence started, and reported by the engine itself.

data.name: Settings_EnableWatchFolder
data.value: Add torrent files from a folder

data.name: Settings_WatchFolderHint
data.value: Torrent files dropped here are added automatically. Each one is renamed rather than deleted once it has been taken.

data.name: Settings_EnableSchedule
data.value: Use different limits at certain times

data.name: Settings_ScheduleHint
data.value: While the window is open these limits replace the ones above. A closing time earlier than the opening time runs through midnight.

data.name: Settings_EnableAutoSearch
data.value: Run a saved search on its own

data.name: Settings_AutoSearchHint
data.value: The query runs on the indexer above and adds anything it has not added before. Fifteen minutes is the shortest interval it will use.
